This biome tag can specify the biome directly. Or specify another biome tag by starting with #
An entry can also be expanded to have a 'required' field set to false. This entry will be skipped if the tag or biome doesn't exist.
This is perfect for supporting modded and datapack biomes! Fabric provides `c` tags that you can use.
Please use `c` and `minecraft` biome tags as much as possible to maximize mod/datapack compatibility.
For this tag, you could add `c:is_outer_end_island` instead of the two below tags if you only want biomes that are big islands.
